<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def g(fr,r0,c0):
    A=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if A[r0+r][c0+c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(5)) for r in range(5))
def pink(fr): return [g(fr,52,15+7*c) for c in range(5)]
def curcol(fr):
    A=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cs=[c for r in (48,49) for c in range(64) if A[r][c]=='W']
    return sum(cs)/len(cs) if cs else None
fr=current_frame
print("start pink:", [x[2] for x in pink(fr)], "curcol:", curcol(fr))
seq={}
stop=False
for s in [1,2,3,4]:
    for _ in range(6):
        cc=curcol(fr)
        if cc is not None and abs(cc-(17+7*s))<=3: break
        res=action(['RIGHT'])
        if res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete'): stop=True; break
        fr=transitions[-1].after_frame
    if stop: break
    seq[s]=[]
    for k in range(10):
        res=action(['UP'])
        if res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete') or res.get('done'): stop=True; break
        fr=transitions[-1].after_frame
        seq[s].append(pink(fr)[s])
    if stop: break
# sanity: compare last read vs current_frame
san = pink(fr)==pink(current_frame)
print("sanity fresh:", san, "timer px:", sum(1 for r in range(60,64) for c in range(64) if current_frame.ascii.split('\n')[r][c]=='W'))
for s in [1,2,3,4]:
    print("slot",s,["|".join(gl) for gl in seq[s]])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
